intuition: Every valid concatenation contains the same fixed number of equal-width words, so each width-aligned window can be checked with word frequencies.

brute_force.approach: Try every starting index and compare its next totalLength characters against every permutation of words.

optimal.approach: For each word-width offset, slide by whole words while tracking counts and shrink whenever a word is overrepresented.

edge_cases: An empty words list has no concatenation.
Repeated words require frequency counts rather than a set.
Matches can overlap and answers are returned in index order.
